opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jennifer Martin (employee ID E033) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E033.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Jennifer Martin (E033) is a full-time Analyst. She requested admin to Payroll, but Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so admin is not permitted. Maximum for full-time employees is write, so recommending write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E033 shows contractor with basic training (note conflicts; security DB is authoritative). Contractors never get admin; with basic training max is read. Requested admin exceeds read, so recommending read.
reason: Jennifer Martin (E033) requested admin access to Payroll. The Security record (authoritative per the security note) shows she is a contractor with basic security training, making her maximum access read (contractors with basic training: read; never admin). The HR note claiming full-time status conflicts, but the Security DB is noted as authoritative. Since the requested level (admin) exceeds the maximum (read), grant the maximum of read.

content.text:
Let me work through this ticket.

Employee: Jennifer Martin (E033)
Request: admin access to Payroll

Notes:
- HR: role Analyst, full_time, recommends write for Payroll
- Security: role Analyst, contractor, security training basic, recommends read for Payroll. Security says security DB is authoritative and there's a conflict; contractors with basic training max is read.

So there is conflicting employment type: HR says full_time, Security says contractor. Security says its DB is authoritative.

According to policy:
- full_time: up to write, admin only if role owns system. Analyst doesn't own Payroll (Payroll Specialist owns it). So max write.
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training -> read max.

If we go by security's authoritative data, she's a contractor with basic training -> max read. Requested admin > read, so grant read.

The Security agent recommends read. HR recommends write based on full-time. The conflict resolution: security DB is authoritative per security note. So the maximum is read.

Grant read (maximum, since requested admin is above max, grant max = read).

Let me submit read.
